summary: I couldn't judge the outcome: the `outcome/` directory that should hold the changed files is missing, so I have no evidence that the change in athena.toml is correct. The request itself also pulls against BRIEF.md. It weakens a protected history check, and it is the third time the same exemption has been used as the fix, while the brief asks Athena to favour fixing root causes.

findings.text: The job's changed files were not provided, so I could not check the new exemption entry, its explaining comment, or the changelog. I can't confirm the outcome serves the goals.
findings.evidence: OUTCOME.md lines 15-16 list CHANGELOG.md and athena.toml. Glob of outcome/**/* returned 'No files found', and reading outcome/athena.toml and outcome/CHANGELOG.md returned 'File does not exist'.

findings.text: The job turns a red check green by exempting the commit it fails on. The 2026-10-16 addendum says the warden holds any landing that touches a check or weakens it, and that only the owner changes those rules. Yet the job is recorded as landed with no sign of a warden hold or owner approval.
findings.evidence: OUTCOME.md line 7: 'Add 39962ed02fec9da2d87cd4a3e287121ed229cd0f to [history] exempt in athena.toml'. Line 11: 'landed: verified and landed'. BRIEF.md addendum 2026-10-16: 'A warden role guards the boundaries: protected files (... grader prompts and thresholds) ... and holds any landing that touches them or weakens a check.'

findings.text: This is at least the third exemption for the same kind of failure, a squash merge breaking the history chain. That points to a root cause nobody has fixed in how squash merges and PRs are handled. The brief asks for root-cause fixes and for every commit on main to trace to accepted work.
findings.evidence: OUTCOME.md line 7: 'the same remedy as ee4b0dd (D66) and f2a8453 (D70)'. BRIEF.md addendum 2026-10-13: 'Have Athena favor fixing root causes'. 'How I'll judge it' requires: 'Every commit on main traces to accepted work.'

findings.text: The exempted squash carries a job whose PR was closed unmerged. That means work that was never accepted reached main. The exemption hides this rather than recording it as an escaped error.
findings.evidence: OUTCOME.md line 7: 'the squash that carried both job 20261010-154004-60r4 (its PR #129 was closed unmerged) and job 20261017-121143-sg0j'. BRIEF.md A5: 'Nothing reaches the main branch, and nothing deploys, without passing verification.'
